company_name: Indian Design, Semiconductors, Packaging and Systems (IDSPS)
semiconductor_relevance: High — IDSPS is deeply involved in advancing semiconductor research and development, particularly in advanced packaging and integrated systems.
summary: IDSPS is a national initiative in India focused on semiconductor R&D, collaborating with top institutions to develop manufacturable prototypes in advanced packaging, integrated optoelectronics, and power electronics. It also emphasizes education and global partnerships to enhance India's semiconductor capabilities.
capabilities: Collaboration with global industry partners for system co-development
Education of technical engineers and Ph.D. scholars

regional_presence.India: IDSPS is a national initiative with a focus on enhancing semiconductor capabilities and sustainable manufacturing growth in India.
